mods.name: AStages
mods.description: Like any other staging mod, but better!

releases.notes:
## [2.5.3] - 09-09-2026


New Features

- Add stage management methods for players and servers. ([#289](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/289))
- Implement mixin to manage menu opening and block stage ownership. ([#292](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/292))

Bug Fixes

- Prevent unnecessary calls to show/hide in recipe viewers. ([#291](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/291))
- Fix player UUID handling and nullability checks in Crafter block. ([#293](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/293))
- Update item pickup restriction to use server and player context (1.21.X only). ([#300](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/300))

API Changes

- Kubejs exposed methods now have default value set to true. ([#288](https://github.com/Alessandro-Casale/AStages/pull/288))
